source_text: This tension underscores a causal divide: UN absolutism assumes uniform harm across contexts, yet empirical gaps in Asia-specific prevalence data—reliant on self-reported surveys—limit verification, with India's non-endorsement of targeted conventions preserving space for community defenses rooted in religious freedom.
